test_commands.spec_tests: npx vitest run src/worker/enrich src/worker/fetcher src/web

dependencies.reason: stores settings on package 01's users, edits its links, and extends its settings page, card, detail page, API conventions, OpenAPI document and test helpers
enriches the reader-view text package 02's fetch worker stores, is triggered by its fetch and refresh, skips the links its notes mark, and shows results through its change feed

tasks.title: Store and verify the owner's AI key
steps: Add the key behaviours to src/worker/enrich/keys.test.ts and src/web/pages/Settings.test.tsx and confirm they fail

Add migrations/0003_ai_enrichment.sql: the users columns ai_provider, ai_model, ai_key_ciphertext, ai_key_iv, ai_key_last4, ai_key_status, ai_key_rejected_message and throttle_next_at; the links columns summary, topic_id, enriched_at, enrichment_status, enrichment_reason and edited_fields; the tables topics, tags and link_tags, each unique per user and name
Add the secret KEY_ENCRYPTION_KEY and the variables ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and OPENROUTER_BASE_URL (defaulting to the providers') to wrangler.jsonc, the Env type and docs/configuration.md

Extend the test helpers with a fake AI provider (src/worker/test/ai.ts, registered on package 01's outbound router src/worker/test/outbound.ts) answering the Anthropic Messages and OpenRouter chat-completions endpoints by a scripted table and logging every request

Write the provider clients in src/worker/enrich/providers.ts: Anthropic through @anthropic-ai/sdk's messages.create, OpenRouter through @openrouter/sdk's chat.send (or its HTTP API if the SDK does not run on Workers), both with the base URL from configuration, a 60-second timeout, and a minimal test request
Write src/worker/enrich/keys.ts: AES-GCM encryption under KEY_ENCRYPTION_KEY with a fresh IV and the user id as additional data, and decryption

Implement PUT, GET and DELETE /api/v1/settings/ai with the validation errors, key_rejected carrying the provider's message, provider_unavailable as 502, the default model claude-opus-5-5, and only the last 4 characters ever returned
Extend the api() helper's recorded responses with the check that no saved test key appears in any body or header

Build the AI section of the Settings page: provider choice with Anthropic preselected, key and model inputs (model required for OpenRouter), 'key verified', the provider's message, '…last4', Replace and Remove
Document the routes in the OpenAPI document and docs/api.md

tasks.title: Enrich fetched links with the owner's key
steps: Add the enrichment behaviours to src/worker/enrich/enrich.test.ts and src/worker/enrich/providers.test.ts and confirm they fail
Add the ENRICH_QUEUE binding (producer and consumer, wired in src/worker/index.ts) to wrangler.jsonc and the Env type

In the fetch worker, after a fetch or refresh makes a link 'active': with a verified key send an ENRICH_QUEUE message and mark the link 'queued'; without a key mark it 'no_key'; for the notes 'not a web page', 'no text in this PDF' and 'PDF too large to store (50 MB limit)' mark it 'skipped' and send nothing

Build the request in src/worker/enrich/enrich.ts: instructions, title, host, the user's 100 most used topics and 300 most used tags, and the first 20,000 characters of link_texts or, for an empty reader view, the title and description; nothing else
Ask each provider for structured {summary, tags, topic}: a forced tool call for Anthropic, a JSON-schema response format for OpenRouter

Normalise the result (tags lower-cased, spaces to hyphens, other characters dropped, no empties or repeats, first 8; summary to 60 words) and treat fewer than 3 tags, an empty summary or topic, or an unparseable answer as a failure
Resolve tag and topic names against the user's vocabulary in src/worker/enrich/vocabulary.ts, reusing a name equal ignoring case with spaces read as hyphens and creating one otherwise
Store summary, tags, topic, enriched_at and status 'enriched', always with the user's own decrypted key and model
Leave enriched links untouched when the provider, model or key changes

tasks.title: Show summary, tags and topic on the card
steps: Add the display behaviours to src/worker/enrich/enrich.test.ts, src/web/components/LinkCard.test.tsx and src/web/pages/Stream.test.tsx and confirm they fail
Include summary, tags, topic, enrichment_status, enrichment_reason and edited_fields in every link object the API returns, and in the OpenAPI document's link schema
Show on the card the summary clamped to two lines with a 'more' control, one chip per tag, and the topic
Keep the stream's change-feed polling running while any card's enrichment is queued, or a pending link will be enriched

tasks.title: Throttle background jobs to 20 per minute per user
steps: Add the throttle behaviours to src/worker/enrich/throttle.test.ts and confirm they fail

Write scheduleThrottled(userId, jobs) in src/worker/enrich/throttle.ts: each job's slot is 3 seconds after the user's previous slot (users.throttle_next_at) or now when that has passed, updated atomically so concurrent calls never share a slot
Send each job's message with delaySeconds = slot - now, at most 43200; carry the slot in the message, and on arrival before the slot send it again for the time left instead of processing it
Export the scheduler for package 07's imported links, and describe it in docs/architecture.md

tasks.title: Work without a key and enrich all unenriched links later
steps: Add the no-key and enrich-all behaviours to src/worker/enrich/enrich.test.ts, src/web/pages/Stream.test.tsx and src/web/pages/Settings.test.tsx and confirm they fail

Implement POST /api/v1/links/enrich-unenriched: 409 no_ai_key without a verified key; otherwise schedule every link in 'no_key', 'waiting_for_key' or 'failed' through scheduleThrottled, mark them 'queued' and answer 202 {queued: n}
Count unenriched_count (links in 'no_key', 'waiting_for_key' or 'failed') in GET /api/v1/settings/ai
Show the banner 'not enriched: add an AI key in settings' once above the stream while there is no key and unenriched_count > 0
Add 'Enrich all unenriched links (n)' to the Settings page and report 'queued n links'
Document the route in the OpenAPI document and docs/api.md

tasks.title: Retry failed enrichments once and let the owner re-run them
steps: Add the failure and re-run behaviours to src/worker/enrich/enrich.test.ts and src/web/components/LinkCard.test.tsx and confirm they fail

On a failed automatic attempt (provider error, rate limit, refusal, 60-second timeout, invalid result) keep the fetched title and description, mark 'failed' with enrichment_reason, and send the message again with delaySeconds 600 when it was the first attempt

Implement POST /api/v1/links/{id}/enrich: 409 no_ai_key without a verified key, 409 nothing_to_enrich for a pending, unreachable or skipped link, else an immediate message outside the throttle and 202 {status: 'queued'}
Show 'enrichment failed' and a 're-run enrichment' action on the card
Document the route in the OpenAPI document and docs/api.md

tasks.title: Pause enrichment on a rejected key and report it once
steps: Add the rejection behaviours to src/worker/enrich/enrich.test.ts, src/web/pages/Settings.test.tsx and src/web/pages/Stream.test.tsx and confirm they fail
On a provider answer of 401, 402 or 403 mark the key 'rejected' with the provider's message and the link 'waiting_for_key', without counting an attempt or retrying
While the key is rejected, mark every link reaching enrichment 'waiting_for_key' without calling the provider
On saving a key that verifies, set the status 'verified', clear the message and lift the pause, leaving waiting links for 'enrich all'
Show 'your AI key was rejected: <provider message>' once at the top of the Settings page while the key is rejected

tasks.title: Let the owner's edits win over automatic values
steps: Add the edit behaviours to src/worker/enrich/edits.test.ts and src/web/pages/LinkDetail.test.tsx and confirm they fail
Implement PATCH /api/v1/links/{id} for title, summary, tags and topic with the limits and 400 codes, refusing the whole request on any invalid field, and append each given field to edited_fields
Normalise edited tags and topics as provider names are and resolve them against the user's vocabulary
Make the enrichment worker skip edited summary, tags and topic, and the fetch worker skip an edited title, on every enrichment, re-run and refresh
Add in-place editing of the four fields to the detail page, sending only changed fields and marking edited ones
Document the route in the OpenAPI document and docs/api.md (package 04 adds the note field to the same route)
